blocks.text: as ... as va than — teng, teng emas, necha baravar

Asosiy qoliplar qizil kitobda o'tilgan: **as** + sifat + **as** (teng), **not as ... as** (teng emas), qiyosiy + **than** (→ qizil kitob, 88–89-darslar). Bu darsda ular ustiga quriladigan B1–B2 darajadagi nozikliklar: **not so ... as**, farq o'lchami (**just as**, **not quite as**, **not nearly as**), miqdor (**as much / as many**), baravarlar (**twice as ... as**), **the same as** va uning «qo'shnilari» (**similar to**, **different from**), shuningdek **than** / **as** dan keyingi olmosh va yordamchi fe'l. O'zbekchada bularga «-dek», «-chalik emas», «... baravar», «-dan» to'g'ri keladi.
not as ... as, not so ... as va farq o'lchami

Inkor gapda birinchi **as** o'rnida **so** ham kelishi mumkin: The film is **not so** good **as** the book. Bu biroz eskiroq va kitobiyroq uslub; so'zlashuvda **not as** ko'proq. Darak gapda faqat **as**: «so big as» xato. Farq qanchalik katta ekanini as ... as oldidagi so'z ko'rsatadi: **just as** (xuddi ...dek), **almost / nearly as** (deyarli), **not quite as** (unchalik emas — kichik farq), **not nearly as** va so'zlashuvdagi **nowhere near as** (umuman ...chalik emas — katta farq). **not as ... as** va **less ... than** ma'nosi bir: The metro is **less expensive than** a taxi = **isn't as expensive as** a taxi. Qisqa sifatlarda esa doim not as ... as tanlang: «less cheap» emas (→ 105-dars).

items.text: The new stadium isn't **nearly as big as** people expected.
items.translation: Yangi stadion odamlar kutganchalik **umuman katta emas**.

items.text: Your cooking is **just as good as** your mother's!
The bus isn't **quite as fast as** the metro, but it's cheaper.
items.translation: Avtobus metrochalik **unchalik tez emas**, lekin arzonroq.

blocks.text: as much / as many / as often as — fe'l va ot bilan

**as ... as** ichida faqat sifat emas, ravish ham keladi: as **fast** as, as **often** as, as **well** as I can. Miqdor uchun: **as much** + sanalmaydigan ot (as much money as), **as many** + ko'plik ot (as many people as); fe'l bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri: I don't earn **as much as** you. **as many as / as much as** + son — sonning kattaligini ta'kidlaydi: **as many as** 2,000 people — **naq** ikki ming kishi. Adashtirmang: **as soon as** — «...-ishi bilanoq» (vaqt bog'lovchisi, → 25-dars), **as long as** — «...-sa bas» (shart, → 115-dars), **as well as** — ba'zan «...dek yaxshi», ba'zan «shuningdek, ... bilan birga».

items.text: I don't go to the cinema **as often as** I used to.
Take **as many** brochures **as** you like — they're free.
**As many as** forty flights were cancelled because of the fog.
items.translation: Tuman tufayli **naq** qirqta reys bekor qilindi.

blocks.text: twice as ... as, half as ... as — baravarlar

Necha baravar farq borligini aytish uchun **as ... as** oldiga **twice** (ikki baravar), **three times**, **ten times** yoki **half** (yarmicha) qo'yiladi: **twice as** expensive **as**, **three times as** many students **as**, **half as** long **as**. Ot bilan qisqa shakl ham bor: **twice the price** (narxi ikki baravar), **half the size** (hajmi yarmicha). So'zlashuvda **three times more expensive than** ham eshitiladi, lekin **twice** bilan faqat **twice as ... as** — «twice more» deyilmaydi. O'zbekchada tartib teskari: «ikki baravar **qimmat**» — inglizchada **twice as** expensive **as**.

rows: **three times as** many students **as** last year
o'tgan yilgidan uch baravar ko'p talaba

blocks.text: the same as, similar to, different from

**the same as** — «... bilan bir xil», o'rtada ot ham kelishi mumkin: the same **height** as, the same **hotel** as. Taqqoslanadigan narsa aytilmasa, **as** tushib qoladi: Our phones are **the same**. Kuchaytirish: **exactly the same**, **almost the same**; inkor: **not the same as**. Qo'shni iboralar: **similar to** — o'xshash («similar with» emas), **different from** — farqli (British English'da **different to** ham bor). **like** bu qoliplarga kirmaydi: «the same like» — xato. like va as farqi — 117-darsda.

items.text: My new job is **similar to** my old one, but the pay is better.
items.translation: Yangi ishim eskisiga **o'xshaydi**, lekin maoshi yaxshiroq.

items.text: Is British English very **different from** American English?
items.translation: Britaniya inglizchasi Amerika inglizchasidan juda **farq qiladimi**?

items.text: We were born in **the same** year, but we went to different schools.
items.translation: Biz **bir** yilda tug'ilganmiz, lekin turli maktablarda o'qiganmiz.

blocks.text: than me yoki than I am? Ikki ma'noli gaplar

Qoida qizil kitobdan ma'lum (→ qizil kitob, 88–89-darslar): so'zlashuvda obyekt olmoshi — than **me**, as **him**; to'liqroq — ega + yordamchi fe'l: than **I am**, as **he does**; yolg'iz «than I» juda rasmiy. Yordamchi fe'l ba'zan **zarur**, chunki ma'noni aniqlaydi: I like Aziz more **than her** — «Azizni u qizdan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman», I like Aziz more **than she does** — «Azizni u qiz yaxshi ko'rganidan ham ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman». **than** dan keyin butun gap ham kelishi mumkin: than **it looks** (ko'rinishidan), than **it used to be** (avvalgidan), than **I expected**. Foydali iboralar: **than ever** (har qachongidan), **than anyone else** (hammadan), **than any other** + birlik ot (boshqa har qanday ...dan).

rows: Azizni u qizdan ko'ra ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman (= than I like her).
I like Aziz more **than she does**.
Azizni u qiz yaxshi ko'rganidan ham ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman.
She's more patient **than she used to be**.
The bag is heavier **than it looks**.
He works harder **than any other** student.
U boshqa har qanday talabadan ko'ra ko'proq mehnat qiladi.

items.text: The roads are busier **than ever** this summer.
Aziz plays the piano better **than anyone else** in his class.
The parcel arrived sooner **than I expected**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «not as big than» → **not as big as**; «so big as» (darak gapda) → **as big as**; «twice more expensive» → **twice as expensive**; «as many money» → **as much money**; «the same like», «the same with» → **the same as**; «similar with» → **similar to**; «He is taller than I» (so'zlashuvda g'alati) → taller **than me** / **than I am**; «than him is» → **than he is**; «ikki baravar katta» ni «two times bigger» deb ko'chirish → **twice as big as**.

O'zbekchadan inglizchaga: «-dek, -day» → **as ... as**; «-chalik emas» → **not as ... as**; «umuman ...chalik emas» → **not nearly as ... as**; «... baravar» → **twice / three times as ... as**; «bilan bir xil» → **the same as**; «-ga o'xshaydi» → **similar to**; «-dan farq qiladi» → **different from**; «-dan ...roq» → **than**.
Bog'lanish: qiyosiy shakllar — 105-dars; much / far / a bit + qiyosiy — 106-dars; orttirma daraja — 108-dars; as soon as — 25-dars; as long as — 115-dars; like va as — 117-dars.

rows: **just / nearly / not quite / not nearly as** ... **as**
**the same as / similar to / different from**
**than me / than I am / than ever**

examples.title: **not as** ... **as** / **not so** ... **as**
examples.description: Teng emaslik: «...chalik emas». Inkorda birinchi **as** o'rnida **so** ham kelishi mumkin (kitobiyroq).

sentences.text: The new shopping centre isn't **as crowded as** the old bazaar.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi eski bozorchalik **gavjum emas**.

sentences.text: Manchester isn't **as expensive as** London, but salaries are lower too.
sentences.translation: Manchester Londonchalik **qimmat emas**, lekin maoshlar ham pastroq.

sentences.text: My second novel didn't sell **as well as** my first.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi romanim birinchisichalik **yaxshi sotilmadi**.

sentences.text: Life in a small town is not **so stressful as** life in the capital.
sentences.translation: Kichik shahardagi hayot poytaxtdagi hayotchalik **og'ir emas**.

sentences.text: The interview wasn't **as difficult as** Jasur had feared.
sentences.translation: Suhbat Jasur qo'rqqanchalik **qiyin bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Public transport in Fergana isn't **as reliable as** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Farg'onada jamoat transporti Toshkentdagichalik **ishonchli emas**.

sentences.text: Why don't you visit us **as often as** you used to?
sentences.translation: Nega bizni avvalgidek **tez-tez** yo'qlamaysiz?

sentences.text: I'm afraid this year's harvest isn't **so good as** last year's.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bu yilgi hosil o'tgan yilgichalik **yaxshi emas**.

sentences.text: Emma can't cook **as well as** her mother, but she's learning fast.
sentences.translation: Emma onasichalik **yaxshi** ovqat pishira olmaydi, lekin tez o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Running a small business is not **as easy as** it looks on social media.
sentences.translation: Kichik biznes yuritish ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ko'ringanchalik **oson emas**.

examples.title: **just as**, **not quite as**, **not nearly as**
examples.description: Farq o'lchami: **just as** (xuddi ...dek), **almost / nearly as** (deyarli), **not quite as** (unchalik emas), **not nearly / nowhere near as** (umuman ...chalik emas).

sentences.text: The copy looks **just as good as** the original painting.
sentences.translation: Nusxa asl kartinaning **xuddi o'zidek** ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: The film wasn't **nearly as exciting as** the book.
sentences.translation: Film kitobchalik **umuman qiziqarli emasdi**.

sentences.text: Our new flat is **almost as big as** our old house.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartiramiz **deyarli** eski uyimizchalik **katta**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's English isn't **quite as fluent as** her sister's yet.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ingliz tili hali opasinikichalik **unchalik ravon emas**.

sentences.text: Homemade lemonade is **just as refreshing as** expensive drinks from the shop.
sentences.translation: Uyda tayyorlangan limonad do'kondagi qimmat ichimliklardek **xuddi shunday tetiklashtiradi**.

sentences.text: The sequel was **nowhere near as funny as** the first film.
sentences.translation: Davomi kulgililik jihatidan birinchi filmning **yoniga ham yo'lamaydi**.

sentences.text: Is the train **nearly as fast as** the plane on this route?
sentences.translation: Bu yo'nalishda poyezd **deyarli** samolyotdek **tez**mi?

sentences.text: Bekzod works **just as hard as** his colleagues, but he earns less.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hamkasblaridek **xuddi shunday astoydil** ishlaydi, lekin kamroq maosh oladi.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the hotel wasn't **quite as close** to the beach **as** the website suggested.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, mehmonxona saytda ko'rsatilganchalik plyajga **unchalik yaqin emas** edi.

sentences.text: Online meetings are convenient, but they're **not nearly as productive as** face-to-face ones.
sentences.translation: Onlayn yig'ilishlar qulay, lekin yuzma-yuz uchrashuvlarchalik **umuman samarali emas**.

examples.title: **as much** / **as many** / **as often as**
examples.description: Miqdor va takror: **as much** + sanalmaydigan ot, **as many** + ko'plik ot, **as often as**; **as many as** + son — «naq».

sentences.text: I don't earn **as much as** my brother, but I have more free time.
sentences.translation: Men akamchalik **ko'p pul topmayman**, lekin bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq.

sentences.text: There weren't **as many** people at the concert **as** we had expected.
sentences.translation: Konsertda biz kutganchalik **ko'p odam yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Try to drink **as much** water **as** you can in hot weather.
sentences.translation: Issiq kunlarda **imkon qadar ko'p** suv ichishga harakat qiling.

sentences.text: We don't eat out **as often as** we did before the children were born.
sentences.translation: Bolalar tug'ilishidan oldingidek **tez-tez** tashqarida ovqatlanmaymiz.

sentences.text: **As many as** two thousand runners took part in the Tashkent marathon.
sentences.translation: Toshkent marafonida **naq** ikki ming yuguruvchi qatnashdi.

sentences.text: Sarah travels **as much as** her job allows.
sentences.translation: Sara ishi imkon bergancha **ko'p** sayohat qiladi.

sentences.text: The repairs could cost **as much as** five thousand pounds.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirlash **besh ming funtgacha** turishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Does Jasur call his parents **as often as** he should?
sentences.translation: Jasur ota-onasiga kerakli darajada **tez-tez** qo'ng'iroq qiladimi?

sentences.text: Our team didn't score **as many** goals this season **as** last season.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz bu mavsumda o'tgan mavsumdagichalik **ko'p gol** urmadi.

sentences.text: Please give me **as much** notice **as** possible if you need a day off.
sentences.translation: Agar dam olish kuni kerak bo'lsa, menga **imkon qadar oldinroq** xabar bering.

examples.title: **twice as** ... **as**, **half as** ... **as**
examples.description: Baravarlar: **twice / three times / half as ... as**; ot bilan qisqa shakl — **twice the price**, **half the size**.

sentences.text: A taxi to the airport costs **twice as much as** the express bus.
sentences.translation: Aeroportgacha taksi ekspress avtobusdan **ikki baravar qimmat**.

sentences.text: Our new office is **three times as big as** the old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisimiz eskisidan **uch baravar katta**.

sentences.text: The new washing machine uses **half as much** water **as** our old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi kir yuvish mashinasi eskisiga qaraganda **ikki baravar kam** suv sarflaydi.

sentences.text: **Three times as many** students applied for the scholarship this year **as** last year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil stipendiyaga o'tgan yilgidan **uch baravar ko'p** talaba ariza topshirdi.

sentences.text: With the new road, the journey to Bukhara takes **half as long as** before.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l tufayli Buxoroga yo'l avvalgidan **ikki baravar kam** vaqt oladi.

sentences.text: Is a flat in London really **twice as expensive as** one in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Londondagi kvartira rostdan ham Edinburgdagidan **ikki baravar qimmat**mi?

sentences.text: Madina reads **twice as fast as** I do.
sentences.translation: Madina mendan **ikki baravar tez** o'qiydi.

sentences.text: The second-hand laptop was **half the price** of a new one, and it works perfectly.
sentences.translation: Ishlatilgan noutbuk yangisining **yarim narxiga** tushdi va a'lo ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Fuel prices are now **three times higher than** they were ten years ago.
sentences.translation: Yoqilg'i narxlari hozir o'n yil oldingidan **uch baravar baland**.

sentences.text: Their garden is **twice the size** of ours, so the children have plenty of space.
sentences.translation: Ularning bog'i biznikidan **ikki baravar katta**, shuning uchun bolalarga joy yetarli.

examples.title: **the same as**, **similar to**, **different from**
examples.description: **the same** (+ ot) **as** — bir xil; **similar to** — o'xshash; **different from** — farqli. Taqqoslanadigan narsa aytilmasa, **as** tushib qoladi.

sentences.text: Your phone is **the same as** mine, so we can share chargers.
sentences.translation: Telefoningiz meniki bilan **bir xil**, shuning uchun quvvatlagichni almashib ishlatsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Aziz and I started work on **the same day**, but he was promoted first.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan **bir kunda** ishga kirganmiz, lekin birinchi bo'lib uning lavozimi ko'tarildi.

sentences.text: Kate now has **the same** surname **as** her husband.
sentences.translation: Keytning familiyasi endi eriniki bilan **bir xil**.

sentences.text: Is the price **the same as** last year, or has it gone up?
sentences.translation: Narx o'tgan yilgi bilan **bir xil**mi yoki oshdimi?

sentences.text: My daughter is only twelve, but she's already **the same height as** me.
sentences.translation: Qizim endigina o'n ikkida, lekin bo'yi allaqachon men bilan **barobar**.

sentences.text: Uzbek plov is **similar to** Spanish paella in some ways.
sentences.translation: O'zbek palovi ba'zi jihatlari bilan ispan paelyasiga **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Working in a big company is very **different from** running your own business.
sentences.translation: Katta kompaniyada ishlash o'z biznesingni yuritishdan juda **farq qiladi**.

sentences.text: We stayed in **the same hotel as** last time because the staff were so friendly.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar juda samimiy bo'lgani uchun o'tgan safargi **o'sha mehmonxonada** qoldik.

sentences.text: These two job offers look **the same**, but the second one has longer holidays.
sentences.translation: Bu ikki ish taklifi **bir xil** ko'rinadi, lekin ikkinchisida ta'til uzunroq.

sentences.text: Life in Edinburgh turned out to be quite **different from** what Jasur had imagined.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdagi hayot Jasur tasavvur qilganidan ancha **boshqacha** bo'lib chiqdi.

examples.title: **than me** / **than I am** / **than she does**
examples.description: **than** / **as** dan keyin: obyekt olmoshi (so'zlashuv) yoki ega + yordamchi fe'l; yordamchi fe'l ba'zan ma'noni aniqlaydi.

sentences.text: My younger brother is already taller **than me**.
sentences.translation: Ukam allaqachon **mendan** baland.

sentences.text: Sarah is more patient with the children **than I am**.
sentences.translation: Sara bolalarga **mendan** ko'ra sabrliroq.

sentences.text: Our neighbours spend far more on holidays **than we do**.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ta'tilga **bizdan** ancha ko'p pul sarflaydi.

sentences.text: Nilufar finished the race faster **than she did** last year.
sentences.translation: Nilufar poygani **o'tgan yilgidan** tezroq tugatdi.

sentences.text: I think Tom likes Emma more **than she likes him**.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, Tomning Emmaga mehri **Emmaning unga bo'lgan mehridan** kuchliroq.

sentences.text: You've done much more for this project **than anyone** expected.
sentences.translation: Siz bu loyiha uchun **hech kim kutmaganidan** ham ko'p ish qildingiz.

sentences.text: Of course my grandmother remembers the old Tashkent better **than I do**.
sentences.translation: Albatta, buvim eski Toshkentni **mendan** yaxshiroq eslaydi.

sentences.text: Is your husband older **than you**, or are you the same age?
sentences.translation: Eringiz **sizdan** kattami yoki tengdoshmisiz?

sentences.text: The exam was easier **than I had expected**, so I finished early.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **men kutganimdan** osonroq bo'ldi, shuning uchun erta tugatdim.

sentences.text: James doesn't speak French **as well as he thinks**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms fransuz tilida **o'zi o'ylaganchalik** yaxshi gapirmaydi.

examples.title: **than ever**, **than anyone else**, **than it looks**
examples.description: **than** dan keyin butun ibora yoki gap: than ever, than anyone else, than any other + ot, than usual, than expected, than it looks.

sentences.text: Prices in the shops are higher **than ever** this winter.
sentences.translation: Bu qish do'konlardagi narxlar **har qachongidan** baland.

sentences.text: Dilnoza knows the city better **than anyone else** in our group.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza shaharni guruhimizdagi **hammadan** yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: This year Oliver worked harder **than any other** member of the team.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Oliver jamoaning **boshqa har qanday** a'zosidan ko'ra ko'proq mehnat qildi.

sentences.text: The bus was more crowded **than usual** because of the football match.
sentences.translation: Futbol o'yini tufayli avtobus **odatdagidan** gavjumroq edi.

sentences.text: The trip cost us much less **than we had planned**.
sentences.translation: Sayohat bizga **rejalashtirganimizdan** ancha arzonga tushdi.

sentences.text: After the holiday, Jasur felt more motivated **than ever before**.
sentences.translation: Ta'tildan keyin Jasur o'zini **har qachongidan ham** g'ayratli his qildi.

sentences.text: My new laptop is heavier **than it looks**, so I rarely carry it around.
sentences.translation: Yangi noutbukim **ko'rinishidan** og'irroq, shuning uchun uni kamdan-kam olib yuraman.

sentences.text: Is cycling in Oxford safer **than it used to be**?
sentences.translation: Oksfordda velosipedda yurish **avvalgidan** xavfsizroqmi?

sentences.text: The concert finished later **than expected**, and we missed the last metro.
sentences.translation: Konsert **kutilganidan** kechroq tugadi va oxirgi metroga ulgurmadik.

sentences.text: Nowadays people check their phones more often **than they realise**.
sentences.translation: Bugun odamlar telefonlarini **o'zlari sezganidan** ko'ra tez-tez tekshiradi.

examples.title: Dialogue: comparing two job offers
examples.description: Ikki do'st ikkita ish taklifini taqqoslaydi: **as good as**, **twice as much as**, **the same as**, **than I do**, **than ever**.

sentences.text: — So, have you decided? Is the bank job **as good as** the IT one?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, qaror qildingmi? Bankdagi ish IT dagidek **yaxshi**mi?

sentences.text: — Well, the bank pays **twice as much as** the IT company.
sentences.translation: — Bank IT kompaniyadan **ikki baravar ko'p** maosh to'laydi.

sentences.text: — Twice! But are the hours **the same as** in the IT company?
sentences.translation: — Ikki baravar! Lekin ish soatlari IT kompaniyadagi bilan **bir xil**mi?

sentences.text: — No, I'd work much longer hours **than I do** now.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hozirgidan** ancha ko'p soat ishlashimga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: — And what about the IT job? Isn't it **more interesting than** the bank?
sentences.translation: — IT dagi ish-chi? U bankdagidan **qiziqroq** emasmi?

sentences.text: — Much more! And the team there is friendlier **than any other** team I've worked in.
sentences.translation: — Ancha! U yerdagi jamoa men ishlagan **boshqa har qanday** jamoadan samimiyroq.

sentences.text: — Then money isn't **as important as** you think, is it?
sentences.translation: — Unda pul sen o'ylaganchalik **muhim emas**, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: — Maybe. But my rent is going up, and life is more expensive **than ever**.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Lekin ijaram oshyapti, hayot ham **har qachongidan** qimmat.

sentences.text: — True, but in the end stress costs you **just as much as** rent.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, lekin oxir-oqibat stress ham ijaradek **qimmatga tushadi**.

sentences.text: — You're right. Happiness at work is worth **more than** a bigger salary.
sentences.translation: — Haqsan. Ishdagi baxt katta maoshdan **qimmatroq**.
